settings.breed_blurb: Curious, merry and utterly photogenic — Beagles look dapper in both casual wear and festive ethnic outfits.
settings.tip_lehenga: Medium-length flared lehengas with elastic waistbands suit a Beagle's athletic build — they love to run so comfort is key.
settings.tip_sherwani: A fitted sherwani with contrast piping looks incredibly dapper on a Beagle's compact body. Try classic ivory or midnight blue.
settings.tip_tshirt: Graphic tees with fun prints look great on Beagles. Choose S or M and measure the chest for the best fit.
settings.tip_colours: Earthy tones like rust, mustard and olive complement the Beagle's tricolour coat. Bright red is also a classic look.
